liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Shakedown Street** (1 review): The performance highlights Brent's energetic playing, particularly near the end of the song [26]
- **Stagger Lee** (1 review): The band's playing quality improved significantly by the time this track was performed [18]
- **Space** (1 review): This jam segment is included alongside the drum break in this specific recording version [21]
- **Morning Dew** (1 review): The listener describes the performance of this song as intensely powerful and memorable [18]

## The recordings

- **gd1990-03-18.mtx.hansokolow.96568.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 171 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1990-03-18.naks.andrewf.35401.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 163 min [2]
- **gd1990-03-18.149785.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 172 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]. Said about its sound: The transfer is characterized as having crystal clear audio quality [28]
- **gd1990-03-18.139225.sbd.miller.truck-mix.flac**: soundboard; 21 songs; 178 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]
- **gd1990-03-18.senn-me80.litzenberger.91358.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 170 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [10]. Said about its sound: The recording is described as good, though not great, for a Civic Center audience pull [21]

## Around the show

- The band played energetically for the Connecticut audience during the spring tour dates [19]
- The reviewer considers this the most consistent and flowy show of the entire tour [25]
- The reviewer selects this as the most bluesy performance of the Spring 1990 tour [28]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1990-03-18.mtx.hansokolow.96568.flac16**: transferred by hansokolow; source: Matrix mix (SBD/AUD) [1]. Also: Hansokolow created a ProTools matrix from an SBD feed via ISDN to HCN studios; Sennheiser ME-80 microphones recorded the first row audience feed onto Maxell DAT tapes [1]
- **gd1990-03-18.naks.andrewf.35401.flac16**: taped by Andrew F; transferred by Andrew F; source: Nakamichi CM-300's with CP-4 shotgun capsules > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell MX-90 cassettes, with no Dolby. Mics on stand 7-feet high, set up near the back of the… [2]. Also: Andrew F. taped and transferred the show, using Soundforge for fades and cleanup [2]
- **gd1990-03-18.149785.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  April 7, 2020; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-X90) [3]
- **gd1990-03-18.139225.sbd.miller.truck-mix.flac**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD (Recording Mix) > Dat Master > PCM (Sony Beta L-750) [4]. Also: John Cutler created the live mix in the mobile recording truck for this file [4]
- **gd1990-03-18.senn-me80.litzenberger.91358.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Keith Litzenberger; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Sennheiser ME-80's>Technics SV-MD1 (1st row OTS) [10]
